content: Mekla Lol Deus

Ha wiri lepal yael mala Temach hachang gich! Ye kel hachangcheng la yal ngalgich le sala yoh le re ffesang gich bo gich lol Deus — ngo tos le gich lol. Ila fal la re faileng re togla gich ngo re togla Deus.

Rewol maryarey, igla ila siya mel bo lol Deus, ngo ye ted ffod loh mele sibe toa ngali. Iwe ngo gich si gula le bela budoh Kristus, ngo sibe wochog iy, bo fal mala si bele wiri mala holngol sangsengal.
Panger rechoka re luglug irel Kristus ngo re mel le re tal, le re wochog iy Kristus le ye tal.
Te tugul semal le be molfid ngo iy ila ye tayikof bo ye hatawsi Hatobtob la yael Deus, bo molfid ila ma hatawsi hatobtob.
Hami ngo ha gola le Kristus ye budoh bo yebe hachuya molfidir yarmat, ngo iy ila yete molfid.
Ila panger rechoka resa sew chog mo Kristus ngo resa chuy mo luwol molfid; ngo semal le yebe ma molfid loh chog ila ted yor mwo yal wiri hare ye gola Kristus.
Ha hafali rewol layi, bo semal de kacheprahmi. Te tugul semal le be foru meka ye bung ngo iy semal cho momay, le yebe tappili chog Kristus le iy semal cho momay.

Iwe ngo semal le yebe taboloh chog yal foru molfid ngo iy chilal Moniyan, bo fael mala Moniyan ila ye faesul molfid doh chog mo irel molwe chapdagel dah. Ila fal yal budoh mala Lol Deus bo yebe hachuya loh yengang ka yael Moniyan.

Ila semal le yebe mel bo lol Deus, ila ngo iy yesa chuy mo luwul molfid, bo molow la yael Deus ila sa mel irel. Iwe ngo fal mala Deus mele Temal, mele iy towol yoh le yebe taboloh chog yal foru molfid.
Iye mele re dil fetang meka lol Deus mo ika lol Moniyan iyang: semal le yebe te foru meka ye bung hare yete hachangi bisil ngo te iy lol Deus.
Ha Hachangi Fengalugmi
Hapatpat we hami ha rongrong mo irel molwe chapdagel dah ila iye: gich sibe rol hachangi fengali gich.

Sibe mel le si towe wochog Cain; iy iwe Moniyan ye wali, iwe yesa limeseloh Abel we spegil bisil. Meda fal le Cain ye limeseloh Abel iyang? Ye limeseloh le fael mokwe iy Cain woal holngol ye foru we ye tayikof. Iwe ngo Abel we bisil ila mokwe ye momay mele iy ye foru.
Ila hami ha towe luwdah rewol bisiy le hare yarmetal faileng le rebe hafobrugmi.
Bo siye gola le si chuy mo irel maes siya bulong luwul molow; si gula mele, la fael mala si hachangir meka wol bisich. Semal le yebe te hachengir yarmat ila ngo iy ye chil mel luwul mala kelel maes.
Ngo semal le yebe hafobdiri bisil ila ngo iy semal rechokwe yema lilimes loh yarmat, ngo hami ha gola le rechoka rema lilimes loh yarmat, ila towe yoh ngalir molow la tor siyal.
Be iye sengal wululul yach be gola mele hachangcheng: Kristus ye fang loh yal ngas bo yagil gich. Ila gich ye momay le sibe wol fang loh yach ngas bo yaglir meka wol bisich.
Hare semal le ye mmal iwe ngo ye sala wiri semal bisil le ye hafohoy, ngo yete kadagi loh molwe bisil, ila ngo be ifa sengal chog ngo sala yoh le yebe sor bo iy ye hachangi Deus?
Rewol layi, yach hachangcheng ila si towe kawraloh chog mo irel yach hapatpat; bo sibe kawraloh mala holngol hachangcheng mo irel yach wegdeg.
Be Kel Depach Fael Metal Deus
Be iye sengal yach be gola le gich ila siya mel irel mala ye katos. Be iye sengal yach be luglug le Deus ye mel irech.
Hare yach luluwal ye sor yach tayikof, ila ngo si gula le Deus ila ye tagiyet tang luluwal ka yach ngo ye gola pangal formel.
Ila, rewol maryarey, hare yach luluwal te sor yach tayikof, ila ngo ye kel lal depach irel mala ye mel Deus irech.
Pangal meka sibe dangro ngo yebe yoh ngalgich bo fael mala si talenga hatobtob kowe yal, ngo si foru mekla ye fel depal iyang.
Mala ye sor ila gich sibe chepar irel molwe Lol we Jesus Kristus, ngo si hachangi semal mo semal le be tapel chog molwe Kristus ye kangal gich.
Iwe ngo semal le ye talenga hatobtob we yael Deus, ngo iy ye mel irel Deus, ngo Deus ye mel irel. Siya gola le ye mel Deus irech le fael Espritu Santus we Deus ye fang ngalgich.
